implementation: Treat V2, Round 12, and Round 14 as legacy comparators. Rename BALF_BLOOD_COPD a reused cross-study benchmark.
Before rerunning, freeze labels, outer/inner groups, candidate families, feature sets, metrics, guardrails, and promotion rule in a committed config.
Use paired productive gd/no productive ab as positives and paired/single productive ab/no gd as separately reported negatives. Keep transcriptomic flags only as stress strata.
Outer folds hold out complete datasets. Inner folds group donor/library and clonotype when available; preprocessing, feature selection, calibration, and thresholds occur inside inner training only.
purpose: Best available honest generalization estimate without new data.

implementation: Cap or weight each dataset and class so HRA005041 does not dominate. Compare matched within-dataset positives and negatives wherever possible.
Compare regularized logistic models using family sums/detection, individual V/J genes, transcriptome lineage features, and combinations. Retain features stable across outer folds.
purpose: Tests whether repertoire-specific V/J signals are portable.

implementation: Generate an out-of-fold high-sensitivity T-lineage probability, then combine it with the gd-versus-ab score. Do not hard-exclude NK-marker-high or TRDV-dropout cells.
purpose: Addresses NK FPs while preserving cytotoxic and dropout-prone gdT cells.

implementation: Calibrate only within inner folds; publish PPV/FDR at 0.1%, 0.25%, 0.5%, 1%, 2%, and 5% prevalence; abstain when critical genes or sufficient panel coverage are missing.
purpose: Makes operating modes interpretable in rare-cell deployment and prevents confident calls from incomplete panels.

implementation: Report strict NK, NKT/MAIT, CD8, CD4/Treg, low-CD3, TRDC+TRDV-, doublet/QC proxies, missing genes, 3-prime versus 5-prime, tissue, disease, and source strata.
purpose: Surfaces clinically relevant failure modes hidden by pooled metrics.

implementation: Use dataset bootstrap confidence intervals and compare the simplest elastic-net/logistic model against gates and trees. Promote complexity only for consistent macro-fold gains.
purpose: Controls variance and supports portable deployment.

implementation: Run label permutation within dataset/donor and predict source from candidate features. Large residual performance or source predictability indicates confounding.
purpose: Directly tests source leakage using current data.

implementation: Require pickle fields, registry, manifest, run summary, training composition, command, Git commit, environment, and input hashes to agree before promotion.
purpose: Makes the selected build exactly reconstructable and catches stale mixed-run metadata.
